title: Spicy Irish Hash
description: A vegan twist on the classic Irish dish, featuring crispy hash browns and a spicy kick.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the hash browns and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the roasted peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
